Summary
The MCP server exposing all `recall__*` tools Claude can invoke. Five tools in v1.

## Error Format (consistent across all tools)
```
[recall error: item abc12345 not found | call recall__list_stored() to browse available items]
```

## Tool Specifications

### `recall__retrieve(id, query?, max_bytes?)`
- Description: *"Fetch stored content from a previous tool call. Pass a query to return only relevant sections via FTS. Use when you need more detail from a compressed result."*
- No query → return up to `max_bytes` (default 8192) of full output
- With query → FTS search within that item's `full_output`, return matching chunks within `max_bytes`
- Increment `access_count`, update `last_accessed_at`
- Append pin recommendation if `access_count >= threshold`
- Response header: `[recall: tool_name | original_size | retrieved: query_or_full | id: abc12345]`

### `recall__search(query, tool?, limit?)`
- Description: *"Search across all stored tool outputs by content. Use when you don't have an ID but know what you're looking for. Returns matching items with IDs for retrieval."*
- FTS5 BM25 search across all stored `full_output` for project
- Optional `tool` filter (regex)
- Default `limit`: 5
- Returns: compact table with 8-char ID, tool name, age, matched snippet

### `recall__forget(id?, tool?, all?, older_than_days?, session_id?, confirmed?)`
- Description: *"Delete stored items by ID, tool pattern, session, age, or clear all. Always confirm before clearing all."*
- Single `id` → delete one item
- `tool` regex → delete all matching tool names
- `session_id` → delete all items from that session
- `older_than_days` → delete non-pinned items older than N session days
- `all: true` without `confirmed: true` → return warning with count + prompt to confirm
- `all: true, confirmed: true` → wipe `store` table (preserve `session_days`)

### `recall__list_stored(limit?, offset?, tool?, sort?)`
- Description: *"Browse stored items by recency, access frequency, or size. Use to find a specific item to retrieve or forget."*
- Default `limit`: 10
- `sort`: `"recent"` (default) | `"accessed"` | `"size"`
- Returns: compact table — 8-char ID, tool name, size, access count, age
- Footer: `call list_stored(offset: N) for next page`

### `recall__stats()`
- Description: *"Aggregate session efficiency stats — total savings, compression ratio, token savings, top tools by volume. Use to understand the big picture."*
- Returns: formatted summary with session duration, items stored, bytes saved, compression ratio, top 3 tools
- Also writes `~/.local/share/mcp-recall/{project}/stats.json`

## Checklist
- [ ] `src/server.ts` — MCP server scaffold with all 5 tools registered
- [ ] Implement `recall__retrieve` with FTS query-scoping and cap
- [ ] Implement `recall__search` with BM25 ranking and snippet extraction
- [ ] Implement `recall__forget` — all delete modes + confirmation gate
- [ ] Implement `recall__list_stored` — paginated, 8-char IDs
- [ ] Implement `recall__stats` — aggregate query + stats.json write
- [ ] Pin recommendation in `recall__retrieve` response
- [ ] Consistent error format across all tools
- [ ] All tool descriptions sharp and distinct (Claude routes correctly)

## Checkpoint
- All 5 tools working in a live session
- `recall__retrieve` returns FTS-scoped result when query provided
- `recall__forget(all: true)` requires explicit confirmation
- `stats.json` written to correct path on every `recall__stats()` call
- Error messages include actionable next Summary
Features deferred from v1. Schema is B-ready from day one — these build on the existing foundation without breaking changes.

## Features

### `recall__pin(id)`
- Exempt item from LFU expiry — survives indefinitely until manually forgotten
- `pinned = 1` column already in v1 schema
- Pin recommendation already surfaced in `recall__retrieve` when `access_count >= threshold`

### `recall__note(content)`
- Store Claude's own conclusions, not just tool outputs
- Turns recall from a retrieval cache into a genuine project memory layer
- Schema: same `store` table, `tool_name = '__note__'`, `full_output = content`, `summary = content`

### `recall__export(path?)`
- JSON dump of all stored items to disk before a clear
- Default path: `~/.local/share/mcp-recall/{project}/export-{date}.json`
- Prevents regret on `forget(all: true)`

### Auto-dedup
- Cache hit when same MCP tool called with identical args within configurable TTL per tool type
- Every cached response stamped with `fetched_at` so Claude can reason about staleness
- Opt-out per tool for freshness-critical tools
- Deferred because staleness UX must be right before shipping — silent stale data breaks trust

### FTS Chunking
- Chunk stored content on write (by paragraph, element, or N bytes)
- Index chunks separately — FTS returns precise matching slices instead of whole documents
- Improves `recall__retrieve(id, query)` precision significantly
- Deferred: whole-document FTS is good enough for v1

### Additional Compression Handlers
- CSV/tabular: schema + statistics + row sampling
- Linear/Jira: issue number, title, state, priority, assignee
- Slack: message content with sensitive content policy

## Notes
- All v2 features are additive — no breaking schema changes required
- `pinned` column, `tool_args_json`, `session_id` all already in v1 schema for v2 use
- Open an issue per feature when ready to
